assembly_digest_method: SHA-256 over ordered canonical lines '<path>:<git_blob_sha>\n' for the six overlay components in order, then the output contract

repairs.issue: A causal claim ceiling was required without ever stating which quantity it was a claim about.
repairs.adjudication: The v0.5 post-mortem hypothesis -- that maturity bounds the ceiling independently of design -- was REJECTED as a professional error that would conflate identification with precision. What was adopted is narrower: the ceiling is scoped to an estimand, and while the registered window is open the registered estimand is right-censored, so no causal claim about it is licensed. Randomization keeps identifying the interim outcome, and an analyst may scope the claim there explicitly. Sparse counts never lower the ceiling.
repairs.repair: v0.6 overlay states the scoping rule; contract v4 adds required causal.claim_scope; fixture contract v3 requires every case to declare registered_window_complete so the constraint is checked against declared facts on both sides.

qualification_scope: fresh post-freeze held-out qualification cycle; NOT library-admitted until a valid gate passes.
freeze_rules: Do not edit any frozen component or the bound output contract during a scored cycle.
Held-out cases are generated after this freeze from a seeded generator; the seed is recorded before execution.
Graders may not be broadened to accept an observed output. Construct repairs require a recorded burn and a fresh seed.
Any behavioral failure ends the cycle; repair requires a new candidate version and a new freeze.
